method: Each editable identity master is placed using one explicit uniformly scaled projected anatomical ground-root, authored from inspected support contacts. No bbox-fit, no warps, no separate limb scaling. The zero-alpha border is trimmed only after placement. Cohort action frames require their own corresponding anatomy marks before final selection.
reference: Original native450x400 Pikeman/Goblin/Ogre/Behemoth frames inspected privately; root197,266 follows actual source cohorts, not a universal engine pivot.

canopyGuide.source_anatomical_landmark: Projected midpoint of the two planted foot support contacts; visible lowleft foot remains nearer than right foot.

canopyTracker.source_anatomical_landmark: Same projected standing foot support midpoint as base; armor does not establish a new root.

bristlehog.source_anatomical_landmark: Projected ground point beneath torso between paired fore/hind support legs, not quill bounds or the tail tip.

thornbackBristlehog.source_anatomical_landmark: Corresponding torso-ground mark beneath larger shoulders; crest extremities do not set root.

pakaaProwler.source_anatomical_landmark: Projected ground point beneath longitudinal torso between planted fore/hind paws; tail/head extent excluded.

pakaaGuardian.source_anatomical_landmark: Corresponding torso-ground point; enlarged mature paws/chest/mane preserve continuous adult feline anatomy.
